concerns.text: Task T015 expects input files `data/timing.csv` and `data/memory.csv` but no earlier task produces these artifacts; the required producer tasks are missing, so the performance summary cannot be generated and the success criterion is untestable.

Task T005 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) yet writes all simulation run results to a single shared CSV (`simulation_results_raw.csv`) within a loop over the configuration grid. Without explicit synchronization this creates a hidden shared‑state race condition, violating the parallel‑safe guarantee.
